title.en: A Future That Maps Its Result

tests.code: assert_eq!(block_on(Map { inner: async { 1 }, func: Some(|n: u32| n + 1) }), 2);
let f = Map { inner: async { pause().await; 3 }, func: Some(|n: u32| n.to_string()) }; assert_eq!(block_on(f), "3");
let text = String::from("moved"); let f = Map { inner: pause(), func: Some(move |_: ()| text) }; assert_eq!(block_on(f), "moved");
